arabizi_sentence: Bi l-2aren tase3 3ashar, ken Kellogg ydir masa77a bi Battle Creek bi America, w ken mou2men bi nazariye gharibe 3ajibe: enno l-2akel tayyeb l-mbahhar huwe asel kill l-balawi l-akhla2iye.
english_translation: In the 19th century, Kellogg ran a sanitarium in Battle Creek in America, and he believed in a very strange theory: that tasty, spicy food was the root of all moral calamities.

arabizi_sentence: 7asab ra2yo, la7me w l-bharat btekhalle dam shabeb yfoor w bt7affiz 3andon raghabat w khataya lazem ten2ama3.
english_translation: According to his opinion, meat and spices made young people's blood boil and stimulated desires and sins that needed to be suppressed.

arabizi_sentence: Fa 2arrar yekhteri3 2akel ykoun 2imme bi l-malal w ykoun neshif w bala ta3me, kermal yehadde a3sab nes w ykhalliyon yrakzo bi sala w sheghel w bass.
english_translation: So he decided to invent a food that was the pinnacle of boredom, dry and tasteless, to calm people's nerves and keep them focused only on prayer and work.

arabizi_sentence: Bi yowm men l-iyam, ken huwe w khayyo Will 3am y7awlo yotbokho 2ame7 masloo2, fa tarakou w fallo.
english_translation: One day, he and his brother Will were trying to cook boiled wheat, so they left it and walked away.

arabizi_sentence: Lamma rej3o, la2o l-2ame7 nishif w sar 2ase.
english_translation: When they returned, they found the wheat had dried out and become hard.

arabizi_sentence: Badal ma ykebbou, jarrabo ymarr2ou bi makanit roll, fa tele3 ma3on 3a shekel ra2ayi2 neshfe.
english_translation: Instead of throwing it away, they tried running it through a rolling machine, and it came out as dry flakes.

arabizi_sentence: Hammasouha w 2addamouha la l-marda bi l-mistashfa ka 2akel taher byeksir raghbe w byehazzib nafes.
english_translation: They toasted them and served them to the patients in the hospital as a pure food that breaks desire and disciplines the soul.

arabizi_sentence: Hon ballashit l-mishkle bayn l-ikhwe.
english_translation: This is where the trouble started between the brothers.

arabizi_sentence: Will ken shater bel business, 2allo la khayyo: Ya John, hayda l-2akel metel l-carton, ma 7ada ra7 yeshteri! Khalline zid 3le shwayyet sikkar ta ysir tayyeb.
english_translation: Will was clever with business, and he told his brother: John, this food is like cardboard, nobody will buy it! Let me add a little sugar to make it tasty.

arabizi_sentence: John jann jnouno!
english_translation: John went ballistic!

arabizi_sentence: Sarakh fi w 2allo: Baddak tfassid akhla2 l-2imme bi sikkar? Hayda 2akel la l-3iffe mish la talazzouz!
english_translation: He yelled at him and said: You want to corrupt the morals of the nation with sugar? This is food for chastity, not for pleasure!

arabizi_sentence: Bass Will ma radd 3le, w sara2 l-fikra, zed 3le sikkar, w assas sherkit Kellogg's yalli mna3rifa l-yom.
english_translation: But Will didn't respond to him, and he stole the idea, added sugar, and founded the Kellogg's company that we know today.

arabizi_sentence: W heik, l-2akle yalli n3amalit kermel tkoun 3i2eb w temna3 raghabat, saret hiye terwi2a l-mofadale la l-3alam killo la2ana tayybe w 7elwe.
english_translation: And so, the meal that was made to be a punishment and a suppressant of desires became the favorite breakfast of the whole world because it's tasty and sweet.

arabizi_sentence: Tkheyyal inno kill mla32it Corn Flakes 3am tekila l-yom, ken l-mafroud tkoun frem la shahwetak 7asab khettit docteur John!
english_translation: Just imagine that every spoonful of Corn Flakes you eat today was supposed to be a brake for your desires according to Dr. John's plan!

arabizi_sentence: Bi Battle Creek America, ken fi khayyen John w Will.

arabizi_sentence: Ba3ed ma t2assas l-Hizb l-Qawmi, se7a l-lebneniyye shehdet weladet Hizb l-Kataeb bi senet l-1936.
english_translation: After the Nationalist Party was established, the Lebanese scene witnessed the birth of the Kataeb Party in the year 1936.

arabizi_sentence: Ken fi sira3 fekri ben ro2ya taba3 Antoun Saadeh la Souriya l-Kobra w-ro2yet Pierre Gemayel la Lebnen l-Kiyan.
english_translation: There was an intellectual conflict between Antoun Saadeh's vision of Greater Syria and Pierre Gemayel's vision of Lebanon as an entity.

arabizi_sentence: W bi senet 1949, t2assas kamen l-Hizb l-Taqaddomi l-Ishtiraki 3a id Kamal Joumblatt.
english_translation: And in the year 1949, the Progressive Socialist Party was also established at the hands of Kamal Joumblatt.

arabizi_sentence: Hal ahzeb kenet 3am tne2ish w 3am tostodem ma3 ba3da kermel hawiyyet Lebnen ba3ed l-istiqlel.
english_translation: These parties were debating and clashing with each other over the identity of Lebanon after independence.

arabizi_sentence: Hal tanzimet saret juz2 asase men tarikhna l-siyasi yalli 3am n3isho l-yom.
english_translation: These organizations became an essential part of our political history that we are living today.

arabizi_sentence: T2assas Hizb l-Kataeb bi nisan 1936 3a id Pierre Gemayel w majmu3a men l-shabeb.
english_translation: The Kataeb Party was established in April 1936 at the hands of Pierre Gemayel and a group of young men.

english_translation: The idea came after Gemayel participated in the Berlin Olympics, he was impressed by the organization of the youth there.

arabizi_sentence: l-hadaf l-asase ken khale2 tanzim lebneni 2awe bi2emin bi Lebnen Awalan w byerfod taba3iyye la barra aw mashari3 l-we7de l-souriye aw l-3arabiye.
english_translation: The main goal was to create a strong Lebanese organization that believes in Lebanon First and rejects dependency on the outside or projects of Syrian or Arab unity.

arabizi_sentence: l-Hizb le3eb dor me7wari ta y7aee2 l-istiqlel senet l-1943.

arabizi_sentence: l-Kataebiyye nazzamo muzaharat ded l-intideb l-faransi w defa3o 3an l-Mithaq l-Watani.
english_translation: The Kataeb organized protests against the French mandate and defended the National Pact.

arabizi_sentence: Bi hal mar7ale, baraz l-hizb ka 2ouwe wataniye btes3a la 7emayet kiyan Lebnen w siyadto.
english_translation: In this stage, the party emerged as a national force seeking to protect the entity of Lebanon and its sovereignty.

arabizi_sentence: Ma b7eb kif weslo la2en 2atel nes mish mnee7 - ana ma b7eb ino a7zeb libneniyye mikhtelfe yet2atalo ma3 ba3ed. 3unuf mish l-jaweb
english_translation: I don't like how they got to it because killing people is not good - I don't like that different Lebanese parties fight with each other. Violence is not the answer.

arabizi_sentence: T2assas l-hizb senet l-1958 3a id l-Ra2is Camille Shmoun ba3ed ma khelset welayto l-ri2asiye.
english_translation: The party was founded in 1958 by President Camille Chamoun after his presidential term ended.

arabizi_sentence: Shmoun ken l-laqab taba3o l-Nemr, w fatret hokmo 3tabaret l-3asro l-dahabi la Lebnen, l-iqtisad shehed infiteh w izdihar ma sar metlo men abel.
english_translation: Chamoun's nickname was 'the Tiger', and his rule period was considered the golden age for Lebanon; the economy witnessed openness and prosperity like never before.

arabizi_sentence: l-hadaf ken l-hifaz 3al nizam l-liberali w ta3ziz hquq l-fard.
english_translation: The goal was to preserve the liberal system and strengthen individual rights.

arabizi_sentence: Bi senet l-1943, l-intidab l-faransi sajano bi qal3et Rashaya ma3 Bishara l-Khoury w Riad l-Solh.
english_translation: In 1943, the French mandate imprisoned him in Rashaya Citadel along with Bishara al-Khoury and Riad al-Solh.

arabizi_sentence: Hayda l-tarikh 3ata la Shmoun sha3biye ktir kbire ka za3im watani hamma siyadet Lebnen men l-bidaye.
english_translation: This history gave Chamoun great popularity as a national leader who cared about Lebanon's sovereignty from the beginning.

arabizi_sentence: l-Ahrar rakkazo 3a tlet mhawer.

arabizi_sentence: l-Hurriye l-Iqtisadiye: Rafd l-ishtirakiye w tashji3 l-istithmar.
english_translation: Economic freedom: rejecting socialism and encouraging investment.

arabizi_sentence: l-Infiteh 3al Gharb: Ta2wiyet l-3alaqat ma3 Europa w America.

english_translation: A strong Lebanon: defending Lebanon as a bridge between the East and the West.

arabizi_sentence: Ma3 bidayet l-harb bi senet l-1975, l-hizb assas jinah 3askari in3araf bi isem Numur l-Ahrar bi qiyadet Dany Shmoun.
english_translation: With the start of the war in 1975, the party founded a military wing known as the 'Tigers of the Liberals' led by Dany Chamoun.

arabizi_sentence: l-hizb sharek bi 2ouwa bi l-Jabha l-Lebneniye la muwajahit l-falastiniye w l-yasar.
english_translation: The party participated strongly in the 'Lebanese Front' to confront the Palestinians and the left.

arabizi_sentence: Fi mahattat 2asiye la3ab fiha l-hizb dour.
english_translation: There were harsh phases in which the party played a role.

arabizi_sentence: Hisar Tall l-Za3tar: l-Numur sharako bi hal ma3rake l-damawiye yalli addet la qatel miyet l-mdeniyye w l-muqatilin l-falastiniye.
english_translation: The Siege of Tal al-Zaatar: the 'Tigers' took part in this bloody battle that led to the killing of hundreds of civilians and Palestinian fighters.

arabizi_sentence: Majzaret l-Safra: Hon wa2a3 l-khata2 l-dakhili l-kbir; l-Quwwat l-Lebneniye hajamet marakiz l-Numur la tawhid l-bunduqiye bi l-2ouwa.
english_translation: The Safra Massacre: here the big internal mistake occurred; the Lebanese Forces attacked the 'Tigers' positions to unify the rifle by force.

english_translation: The Syrian Social Nationalist Party was founded in Beirut in 1932 by the thinker Antoun Saadeh.
